scope: Asset-specific continuation of adjoining ground beneath foundations. These are reviewed hidden floor inferences, not new visible terrain or changes to native gameplay obstacles.

york-riverside-stone-storehouse.reason: Door threshold meets the raised town street; the river-facing foundation is hidden.

york-market-north-cream-canopy-stall.reason: Market stall feet stand on the raised market surface.

york-west-city-wall-roofed-stair-turret.reason: Turret entrance meets the raised inner street.

york-southwest-west-gatehouse.reason: Gate entrance meets the raised inner lane.

york-southwest-market-west-low-house.reason: The low house meets the raised inner lane behind the covered link.

york-southwest-market-northwest-house.reason: House facade meets the raised market lane.

york-precinct-causeway-ivy-covered-house.reason: Lower door and stair foot meet the town street; preserve the upper causeway contact separately.

york-precinct-causeway-stone-annex.reason: Annex door meets the lower town street.

york-east-bridge-street-northern-timber-.reason: The house meets the lower street at the foot of the bridge steps, not the upper bridge terrace.

york-east-bridge-street-central-timber-h.reason: The front door meets the lower street, preserving the wall beside the higher stairs.

york-east-bridge-street-stair-side-timbe.reason: The shop frontage and lower stair foot meet the lower street.

york-east-riverside-roofed-link.reason: The covered link meets the lower riverside street.

york-east-quay-front-timber-house.reason: The front house meets the quay landing, below the bridge road.

york-east-quay-rear-timber-house.reason: Continue the shared quay-level foundation under the adjoining rear house; hidden contact is inferred.

york-east-riverside-low-courtyard-wall.reason: The short courtyard wall stands on the upper bridge terrace.

york-castle-courtyard-east-lodge.reason: The lodge door meets the courtyard; the terrain footprint stops at its front facade.

york-castle-west-gatehouse.reason: The gate passage joins the bridge terrace and courtyard at the same elevation.

york-castle-main-keep.reason: The keep door and front facade meet the courtyard; continue that floor beneath the building.

york-castle-courtyard-west-lodge.reason: The west lodge meets the courtyard behind the gate wall.

york-castle-south-round-tower.reason: Use the lower riverside street as the base; retain the tower below the higher courtyard floor.

york-castle-great-hall.reason: The hall meets the courtyard; the hidden foundation continues that floor beneath its footprint.

york-castle-east-round-tower.reason: The tower adjoins the hall and raised courtyard; continue that floor beneath its hidden foundation.

york-castle-courtyard-lodge-stairs.reason: The first stair tread meets the courtyard; its proxy continues to global zero beyond the terrain edge.

york-precinct-east-wall-stair.reason: The wall stair begins on the upper precinct floor; its support volume is behind the terrace rim.
